tasks.label: STM32: Build
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && cube cmake --preset Debug && cube cmake --build build/Debug

tasks.label: STM32: Build, Flash and Run
args: ELF=$(find "${workspaceFolder}/build/Debug" -type f -name \*.elf -print -quit); if [ -z "$ELF" ]; then echo "ERROR: No ELF file found"; exit 1; fi; echo "Flashing: $ELF"; cube programmer -c port=SWD -d "$ELF" --start 0x08000000
